[SWS_DM_00946] Occurrence Counter increment strategy ’testFailed’- only
⌈
If the configuration parameter DiagnosticCommonProps.occurrenceCoun-
terProcessing is set to testFailedBit and a certain event is already stored in
the event memory, for each transition of UDS DTC status bit "kTestFailed"
from ’0’ to ’1’, the DM module shall trigger the increment of the associated occurrence
counter by one.
⌋
